results.question: Trong 2022, vùng nào có average transit time cao nhất và có nên thiết kế lại mạng lưới giao hàng không?

citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Nationwide logistics
citations.sql_query: SELECT g.region, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) AS avg_transit_time_days FROM commerce.shipments AS s JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON o.zip = g.zip WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.delivery_date) = 2022 GROUP BY g.region ORDER BY avg_transit_time_days DESC LIMIT 100
